records.name: Notorious

evidence.conclusion: a7d8c4da96eacad4 is a malformed legacy import: its benefit/description is the concatenation of THREE different published talents' text, none of which is Notorious. It is not an older name for Notorious and not a distinct talent.
findings: Text segment 1 = Shared Notoriety ("When your Minions invoke your name, others take note…"), Core Rulebook TXT line 19846 (printed p.210); canonical Infamy|Shared Notoriety already exists as 9491f34aad83dfb1.

Text segment 2 = Master Manipulator ("When you make a successful Persuasion check, you can immediately make a second Persuasion check…"), Unknown Regions TXT lines 2914-2921; canonical Infamy|Master Manipulator exists as 32fb42ce3ee46e6d.
Text segment 3 = Small Favor ("You can call in a small favor from someone who owes you…"), Unknown Regions TXT line 2923; canonical Infamy|Small Favor exists as 81e423a476c377fa.

Embedded "Reference Book: … Scum and Villainy / Unknown Regions" and "Prerequisites: ," fragments are import-scraper residue, not printed text. Record has no source/page, empty prerequisites, class=Bounty Hunter, category="Bounty Hunter" while sitting in the Crime Lord/Infamy tree.

Real Notorious exists twice canonically and is NOT this record: Infamy|Notorious (Core p.210, Crime Lord: "Your reputation as a crime lord…", production 09744041cdcc9e22) and Bounty Hunter|Notorious (Core p.209: "Your skill as a bounty hunter…", production c67cbd59abd1cc53, created in Phase 3C). Core TXT lines 19654 and 19944.
Both real Notorious rules texts are identical mechanically (reroll Persuasion to intimidate, keep the better result), so repointing actors is rules-neutral.
evidence.whyNotMergeDuplicate: MERGE_DUPLICATE assumes the record carries a copy of the surviving identity. This record carries no Notorious text at all; merging it would launder three other talents' text into Notorious. Because two canonical Notorious identities exist, there is also no single survivor ID; actor references are repointed by class instead.
evidence.pdfNote: TXT is unambiguous (three separately headed talents concatenated; both real Notorious entries are clean in the TXT).

records.name: Teräs Käsi Basics

evidence.conclusion: 222327492c484b4a is a second copy of Threats of the Galaxy | Master of Teräs Käsi | Teräs Käsi Basics: same name (accented), same tree ba726f623e42f849, same prerequisite (Martial Arts I), same benefit (identical except capital "Unarmed"), identical abilityMeta.rules. findings: Same tree ba726f623e42f849 and both listed in system.talentIds; the tree's five-talent canonical roster has exactly one Teräs Käsi Basics (canonical: Threats of the Galaxy p.53, prereq Martial Arts I).

Survivor 67bddb17ae2770f3 was chosen by Phase 3B because it carries the established runtime identity flags.swse.id = swse.talent.teras_kasi_basics, source/page/summary; the duplicate has none of these.

Field diff duplicate vs survivor: only capitalisation of "Unarmed"/"unarmed", empty class/category, extra auto-derived tags (action_economy, controller, damage_reduction, defender, sustained_damage), missing source/page/summary/swse.id, and a different migration timestamp. abilityMeta is identical.
Progression relationship is separate and not affected: Basics is the prerequisite of Ignore Damage Reduction / Teräs Käsi Mastery / Unarmed Counterstrike / Unarmed Parry (prereq strings by name).

Phase 3B/Galaxy at War TXT corroborates the tree (Master of Teräs Käsi); Threats of the Galaxy TXT lacks the tree text, so the canonical p.53 entry rests on the earlier certified Phase 3B authority. No new publication claim is created by this record.
